variableComment:
设置正文语言展现形式及翻译优先级
！错误的设置可能导致书源工作不正常
格式：语言展现形式 - 翻译优先级

语言展现形式：
- 日文
- 中文
- 中日
- 日中
翻译优先级：
- 并列（展示所有存在的翻译）
- 优先级序列，写在前面的优先采用，B-百度、Y-有道、G-GPT、S-Sakura，如 `SGYB`

示例（默认值）：中日 - SGYB
示例：中文 - 并列

searchUrl:
<js>
const headers = JSON.parse(source.header);
const jieqiSearchJs = java.ajax(`${source.bookSourceUrl}/search.html?search_guard=js`).match(/["'](jieqiSearchJs=.*?)["']/)[1].split(';')[0];
const jieqiSearchCss = java.get(`${source.bookSourceUrl}/search.html?search_guard=css`, headers).header('set-cookie');
const cookies = [
    jieqiSearchJs,
    jieqiSearchCss
].join('; ');
headers.Cookie = String(headers.Cookie + '; ' + String(cookies));
cookie.replaceCookie(source.bookSourceUrl, cookies);
const jieqiSearchTicket = java.get(`${source.bookSourceUrl}/search.html?search_guard=redeem&r=${Date.now()}`, headers).header('set-cookie').split('; ')[0];
(page == 1 ?
    '/search.html?searchkey={{key}}' :
    '/search/{{key}}_{{page}}.html') + ',' + JSON.stringify({
    headers: {
        "Cookie": jieqiSearchTicket
    }
});
</js>

<js>
r=`走出便利商店要回家的高中生 菜月・昴（Natsuki・Subaru） 突然被召唤到异世界。

这莫非就是很流行的异世界召唤！？可是眼前没有召唤者就算了，还遭遇强盗迅速面临性命危机。

这时，一名神秘银发美少女和猫精灵拯救了一筹莫展的他。

以报恩为名义，昴自告奋勇要帮助少女找回失物。

然而，好不容易才掌握到线索，昴和少女却被不明人士攻击而殒命 ── 本来应该是这样，但回过神来，昴却发现自己置身在第一次被召唤到这个异世界时的所在位置。

『死亡回归』 —— 无力的少年得到的唯一能力，是死后时间会倒转回到一开始。

※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※ ※

仅仅是作为没有被赋予任何关于异世界知识、技能、力量的普通人，挣扎求存。 他唯一得到的祝福就是 「重生」 —— 触发条件是痛苦的 『死亡』 ！

他死了多少次？ 历经多少死亡方式（剧透慎点）？ 在不可靠的世界种如何夺取希望之物？

但即使跨越无数血液、尸体和绝望，也要从死亡的命运中拯救少女！`
</js>

exploreUrl:
<js>
var discover = [];
var showR18 = false;
var token = source.getLoginHeader();
var push = (title, url, style) => {
    discover.push({
        title: title,
        url: url,
        style: {
            layout_flexGrow: 1,
            layout_flexBasisPercent: style
        }
    });
};
var addSlots = (count, style) => {
    var remainder = count % 3;
    var slotsAdd = remainder === 0 ? 0 : 3 - remainder;
    for (var i = 0; i < slotsAdd; i++) {
        push("", null, style);
    }
};
push("书架", null, 1);
if (!token) {
    showR18 = false;
    push("账号未登录", null, 0.25);
    addSlots(1, 0.25);
} else {
    try {
        var favored = java.ajax(`${baseUrl}/api/user/favored`);
        if (favored.includes("Token不合法或者过期")) {
            showR18 = false;
            push("账号未登录", null, 0.25);
            addSlots(1, 0.25);
        } else {
            showR18 = true;
            push("阅读历史", "/api/user/read-history?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=30", 0.25);
            var favoredData = JSON.parse(favored).favoredWeb;
            favoredData.forEach(item => {
                push(item.title, `/api/user/favored-web/${item.id}?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=30&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=0&level=${token ? 0 : 1}&translate=0&sort=update`, 0.25);
            });
            addSlots(1 + favoredData.length, 0.25);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        showR18 = false;
        push("未知错误", null, 0.25);
        addSlots(1, 0.25);
    }
}
push("来源", null, 1);
var providers = ["全部", "kakuyomu", "syosetu", "novelup", "hameln", "pixiv", "alphapolis"];
providers.forEach(provider => {
    var url = provider === "全部" ? 
        `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=${providers.slice(1).join('%2C')}&type=0&level=${token ? 0 : 1}&translate=0&sort=0` : 
        `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=${provider}&type=0&level=${token ? 0 : 1}&translate=0&sort=0`;
    push(provider, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(providers.length, 0.25);
push("类型", null, 1);
var types = ["全部", "连载中", "已完结", "短篇"];
types.forEach((type, index) => {
    var url = `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=${index}&level=${token ? 0 : 1}&translate=0&sort=0`;
    push(type, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(types.length, 0.25);
push("分级", null, 1);
var levels = showR18 ? ["全部", "一般向", "R18"] : ["一般向"]
levels.forEach((level, index) => {
    var url = `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=0&level=${showR18 ? index : index+1}&translate=0&sort=0`;
    push(level, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(levels.length, 0.25);
push("排序", null, 1);
var sorts = ["更新", "点击"];
sorts.forEach((sort, index) => {
    var url = `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=0&level=${token ? 0 : 1}&translate=0&sort=${index}`;
    push(sort, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(sorts.length, 0.25);
JSON.stringify(discover);
</js>

<js>
var token = source.getLoginHeader();
if (token) {
    update(baseUrl, token);
}
var value = String(book.getVariable("custom")) || String(source.getVariable());
var get = /^[1-9]$/.test(value) ? value : '1';
var config = {
    1: 'sakuraParagraphs',
    2: 'gptParagraphs',
    3: 'youdaoParagraphs',
    4: 'baiduParagraphs',
    5: 'paragraphs'
};
var data = JSON.parse(result);
var content = data[config[get]] || data[config[1]] || data[config[2]] || data[config[3]] || data[config[4]] || data[config[5]];
if (['6', '7', '8', '9'].includes(get)) {
    var cnContent = data[config[1]] || data[config[2]] || data[config[3]] || data[config[4]];
    var jpContent = data[config[5]];
    if (cnContent) {
        if (['8', '9'].includes(get)) {
            var res = java.post(
                'https://static.kksk.io/api/kanji',
                JSON.stringify({"content": format(regex(jpContent)),"chapterUrl": baseUrl}),
                {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
            );
            var kanji = JSON.parse(res.body());
            jpContent = jpContent.map(text => annotate(text, kanji));
        }
        var type = ['6', '8'].includes(get);
        content = jpContent.flatMap((jp, i) => {
            if (!((jp || '').trim() && (cnContent[i] || '').trim())) return [];
            var pair = type ? [cnContent[i], jp] : [jp, cnContent[i]];
            return pair.filter(Boolean).concat(i === jpContent.length - 1 ? [] : '\u200B');
        }).filter(Boolean);
    } else {
        content = jpContent;
    }
}
format(regex(content));
</js>

searchUrl:
<js>
var providers = {
    kakuyomu: /(?:https?:\/\/)?kakuyomu\.jp\/works\/(\d+)/,
    syosetu: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(ncode|novel18)\.syosetu\.com\/(\w+)/,
    novelup: /(?:https?:\/\/)?novelup\.plus\/story\/(\d+)/,
    hameln: /(?:https?:\/\/)?syosetu\.org\/novel\/(\d+)/,
    pixiv: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(www\.pixiv\.net\/novel\/series\/(\d+)|www\.pixiv\.net\/novel\/show\.php\?id=(\d+))/,
    alphapolis: /(?:https?:\/\/)?www\.alphapolis\.co\.jp\/novel\/(\d+)\/(\d+)/,
    sakura: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(?:books\d?\.fishhawk\.top|n\.novelia\.cc|book\.xkvi\.top)\/(?:api\/)?novel\/(\w+)\/([\w-]+)/
};
var url;
for (var provider in providers) {
    var match = key.match(providers[provider]);
    if (match) {
        var providerId = provider === 'sakura' ? match[1] : provider;
        var novelId = provider === 'alphapolis' ? `${match[1]}-${match[2]}` : provider === 'pixiv' ? (match[3] ? `s${match[3]}` : match[2]) : (match[2] || match[1]);
        url = `${baseUrl}/api/novel/${providerId}/${novelId}`;
        break;
    }
}
var token = source.getLoginHeader();
if (!url) {
    url = `${baseUrl}/api/novel?page=${page-1}&pageSize=20&query=${key}&provider=kakuyomu,syosetu,novelup,hameln,pixiv,alphapolis&type=0&level=${token ? 0 : 1}&translate=0&sort=0`;
}
url;
</js>

    }
    String(Rtitle).replace(/[📡]+/g, '📡');
}
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
// 使用 Jsoup 解析 HTML 并定位正文内容节点
let documentObj = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
let contentContainer = documentObj.getElementById("BookText");

// 获取解密乱序内容所需的种子、校验值、属性名及偏移量
let seed = parseInt(contentContainer.attr("data-r"));
let totalCountKey = parseInt(contentContainer.attr("data-t"));
let attributeName = contentContainer.attr("data-a"); 
let offsetKey = parseInt(contentContainer.attr("data-k"));

// 计算应显示的有效段落总数并初始化存储容器
let actualParagraphCount = totalCountKey ^ (seed % 256);
let allParagraphs = contentContainer.select("p");
let validParagraphList = [];

// 遍历段落并还原真实的显示索引
for (let i = 0; i < allParagraphs.size(); i++) {
    let pElement = allParagraphs.get(i);
    let fingerprint = pElement.attr(attributeName);

    // 仅解密带有指纹属性的有效段落
    if (fingerprint) {
        let targetFingerprint = parseInt(fingerprint, 16);
        let recoveredIndex = -1;

        // 通过迭代匹配还原哈希算法混淆前的原始索引
        for (let idx = 0; idx < 1000; idx++) {
            let hashValue = (idx * 31 + offsetKey) >>> 0;
            hashValue = (hashValue ^ ((seed >> 3) & 0xFFFF)) >>> 0;
            
            // 模拟 32 位乘法溢出逻辑计算指纹
            let multiplier = 0x9e3779b1;
            let lowBits = (hashValue & 0xffff) * multiplier;
            let highBits = (hashValue >>> 16) * multiplier + (lowBits >>> 16);
            hashValue = (((highBits << 16) | (lowBits & 0xffff)) >>> 0) & 0xFFFFFF;

            // 匹配指纹成功后记录索引并中止循环
            if (hashValue === targetFingerprint) {
                recoveredIndex = idx;
                break;
            }
        }

        // 将索引合法的段落源码存入待排序数组
        if (recoveredIndex >= 0 && recoveredIndex < actualParagraphCount) {
            validParagraphList.push({
                htmlContent: pElement.outerHtml(),
                orderIndex: recoveredIndex
            });
        }
    }
}

// 清空结果变量并按照还原的索引顺序合并段落
result = "";
validParagraphList.sort((first, second) => first.orderIndex - second.orderIndex);
for (let j = 0; j < validParagraphList.length; j++) {
    result += validParagraphList[j].htmlContent + "\n";
}

result;
</js>

discover = [];
push = (title, url, style) => discover.push({ title: title, url: url, style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: style } });
addSlots = (count, style) => {
    remainder = count % 3;
    slotsAdd = remainder === 0 ? 0 : 3 - remainder;
    for (i = 0; i < slotsAdd; i++) {
        push("", null, style);
    }
};
push("收藏夹", null, 1);
try {
    favored = java.ajax(`${baseUrl}/api/user/favored`);
    if (favored.includes("Token不合法或者过期")) {
        push("账号未登录", null, 0.25);
        addSlots(1, 0.25);
    } else {
        favoredData = JSON.parse(favored).favoredWeb;
        favoredData.forEach(item => {
            push(item.title, `/api/user/favored-web/${item.id}?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=30&sort=update`, 0.25);
        });
        addSlots(favoredData.length, 0.25);
    }
} catch (e) {
    push("未知错误", null, 0.25);
    addSlots(1, 0.25);
};
push("来源", null, 1);
providers = ["全部", "kakuyomu", "syosetu", "novelup", "hameln", "pixiv", "alphapolis"];
providers.forEach(provider => {
    url = provider === "全部" ? 
        `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=${providers.slice(1).join('%2C')}&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=0` : 
        `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=${provider}&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=0`;
    push(provider, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(providers.length, 0.25);
push("类型", null, 1);
types = ["全部", "连载中", "已完结", "短篇"];
types.forEach((type, index) => {
    url = `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=${index}&level=0&translate=0&sort=0`;
    push(type, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(types.length, 0.25);
push("排序", null, 1);
sorts = ["更新", "点击"];
sorts.forEach((sort, index) => {

<js>
providers = {
    kakuyomu: /(?:https?:\/\/)?kakuyomu\.jp\/works\/(\d+)/,
    syosetu: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(ncode|novel18)\.syosetu\.com\/(\w+)/,
    novelup: /(?:https?:\/\/)?novelup\.plus\/story\/(\d+)/,
    hameln: /(?:https?:\/\/)?syosetu\.org\/novel\/(\d+)/,
    pixiv: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(www\.pixiv\.net\/novel\/series\/(\d+)|www\.pixiv\.net\/novel\/show\.php\?id=(\d+))/,
    alphapolis: /(?:https?:\/\/)?www\.alphapolis\.co\.jp\/novel\/(\d+)\/(\d+)/,
    sakura: /(?:https?:\/\/)?books\d?\.fishhawk\.top\/(?:api\/)?novel\/(\w+)\/([\w-]+)/
};
for (provider in providers) {
    match = key.match(providers[provider]);
    if (match) {
        providerId = provider === 'sakura' ? match[1] : provider;
        novelId = provider === 'alphapolis' ? `${match[1]}-${match[2]}` : provider === 'pixiv' ? (match[3] ? `s${match[3]}` : match[2]) : (match[2] || match[1]);
        url = `${baseUrl}/api/novel/${providerId}/${novelId}`;
        break;
    } else {
        url = `${baseUrl}/api/novel?page=${page-1}&pageSize=20&query=${key}&provider=kakuyomu,syosetu,novelup,hameln,pixiv,alphapolis&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=1`;
    }
    url
}
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
let url = baseUrl;
let Thread = Packages.java.lang.Thread;

// 正文加载限制
dex = parseInt(book.durChapterIndex - chapter.index)
if (dex !== 0) {
  // 预加载值
  jz = 2;
  function gen(n) {
    n1 = []; n2 = [];
    n1 = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => -(i + 1));
    n2 = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => i + 1);
  return n1.concat(n2);
  }
  nlist = gen(jz);
  isDex = nlist.includes(dex);
  delay = 10000;
  if (isDex) {
    var idx = nlist.indexOf(dex);
    totalCheckTime = (idx + 1) * 60 * 1000;
    elapsedTime = 0;
    while (book.durChapterIndex !== chapter.index && elapsedTime <= totalCheckTime) {
      try {
        Thread.sleep(delay);
        elapsedTime += delay;
      } catch (e) { break; }
    }
    java.log(chapter.title);
  } else {
    while (book.durChapterIndex !== chapter.index && parseInt(chapter.index - book.durChapterIndex) > jz) {
      try {
        Thread.sleep(delay);
      } catch (e) { break; }
    }
    java.log(chapter.title)
  }
} else { }

// 灰色章节处理
if (/data/.test(url)) {
  burl = java.hexDecodeToString(result);
  if (/baidu.com/.test(burl)) {
    pre = burl.replace("baidu", "bilinovel");
    url = source.getKey().split("#")[0] + java.ajax(pre).match(/prevpage="([^"]+)"/)[1]; 
    Thread.sleep(1000);
    java.setContent(src = java.ajax(url));
  } else {
  nex = burl.replace("cn.bing", "www.bilinovel");
  	do {
    next = "Error 1015";
    while (next == "Error 1015") {
        Thread.sleep(3000);
        next = String(java.ajax(nex));
        if (next != "Error 1015") { break; }
    }
    nex = source.getKey().split("#")[0] + next.match(/nextpage="([^"]+)"/)[1]; 
    /_\d+\.html/.test(nex) ? flag = true : flag = false;
  } while (flag);
  url = nex;
  java.setContent(src = java.ajax(url));
  }
}
// java.log(result)

// 处理页面错误
if (String(result).match(/1015|503/)) {
  Thread.sleep(5000);
  java.setContent(src = java.ajax(url));
}

// 处理设备检测 
if(String(result).match(/反馈设备详细信息|不支持/gi)) {
  // java.log(cookie.getCookie(url));
  cookie.replaceCookie(url, java.webView(null, url, "document.cookie"));
  Thread.sleep(1000);
  java.setContent(src = java.ajax(url));
}
var src = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(src)
var h = src.select('[id*=content]>*:not(script):not(.cgo)')
if (h == "") {
   Thread.sleep(2000)
   var src = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(java.ajax(baseUrl))
   var h = src.select('[id*=content]>*:not(script):not(.cgo)')
}

var st = java.getString('style@html')

if (/woff2/.test(st)) {
    rule = st.match(/#acontent\s+p\s*([^,]+)/)[1];
    selector = `p${rule}`;
    c = h.select(selector).text();
    var f1 = java.queryTTF('https://dns.jingluo.love/fun%2F64%2Fread.ttf');
    var f2 = java.queryTTF('https://dns.jingluo.love/fun%2F64%2Fbili.ttf');
    var res = java.replaceFont(c, f1, f2, true);
    h = String(h).replace(c, res);
}

String(h).replace(/\s*<\/?shirika>\s*/g, '')
</js>

  let res = ''
  data.forEach(i => {

  })
  return res.trim()
}

  let url = 'https://api.sfacg.com/user/newSignInfo'

  let options = {

<js>
eval(String(source.loginUrl));
function deviceType() {
  try {
    return!!java.androidId();
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
}
let device = deviceType()? 'android' : 'ios';
let genreValue = JSON.parse(java.ajax(book.bookUrl)).data[0].genre;
//如果 genre 值为 4，书籍类型赋值为 听书函数
if (genreValue === '4') {
  option = '&tone_id=0';
java.longToast("已自动切换为听书!");
}
// 根据不同条件为 book.type 赋值
if (device === 'android') {
  if (option) {
    // 如果 option 有内容，安卓阅读赋值为 32
    book.type = 32;
java.longToast("已自动切换为听书!");
  } else if (genreValue === '1') {
    // 如果 genre 值为 1，安卓阅读赋值为 64
    book.type = 64;
java.longToast("已自动切换为漫画!");
  } else {
    // 默认情况下，安卓阅读赋值为 8
    book.type = 8;
  }
} else if (device === 'ios') {
  if (option) {
    // 如果 option 有内容，苹果源阅赋值为 1
    book.type = 1;
java.longToast("已自动切换为听书!");
  } else if (genreValue === '1') {
    // 如果 genre 值为 1，苹果源阅赋值为 2
    book.type = 2;
java.longToast("已自动切换为漫画!");
  } else {
    // 默认情况下，苹果源阅赋值为 0
    book.type = 0;
  }
}

function spArr(arr, num) {
  let newArr = []
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length;) {
    newArr.push(arr.slice(i, i += num))
  }
  return newArr
}
let res = JSON.parse(result).data
let item_list = spArr(res["allItemIds"], 100)
let array = []
for (let i = 0; i < item_list.length; i ++) {
  let response = java.ajax('https://novel.snssdk.com/api/novel/book/directory/detail/v1/?item_ids='+item_list[i])
  let data = JSON.parse(response).data
  data.forEach((x) => {
    array.push({
      name: x.title,
      url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(x.item_id)},{"type":"pyfqc"}`,
      info: ((Number(x.volume_name) == 0?"第一卷：默认": x.volume_name)+' · '+java.timeFormat(x.first_pass_time*1000)+' · '+x.chapter_word_number+'字')
    })
  })
}
array
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
eval(String(source.loginUrl));
function deviceType() {
  try {
    return!!java.androidId();
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
}
let device = deviceType()? 'android' : 'ios';
let genreValue = JSON.parse(java.ajax(book.bookUrl)).data[0].genre;
//如果 genre 值为 4，书籍类型赋值为 听书函数
if (genreValue === '4') {
  option = '&tone_id=0';
}
// 根据不同条件为 book.type 赋值
if (device === 'android') {
  if (option) {
    // 如果 option 有内容，安卓阅读赋值为 32
    book.type = 32;
  } else if (genreValue === '1') {
    // 如果 genre 值为 1，安卓阅读赋值为 64
    book.type = 64;
  } else {
    // 默认情况下，安卓阅读赋值为 8
    book.type = 8;
  }
} else if (device === 'ios') {
  if (option) {
    // 如果 option 有内容，苹果源阅赋值为 1
    book.type = 1;
  } else if (genreValue === '1') {
    // 如果 genre 值为 1，苹果源阅赋值为 2
    book.type = 2;
  } else {
    // 默认情况下，苹果源阅赋值为 0
    book.type = 0;
  }
}

function spArr(arr, num) {
  let newArr = []
  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length;) {
    newArr.push(arr.slice(i, i += num))
  }
  return newArr
}
let res = JSON.parse(result).data
let item_list = spArr(res["allItemIds"], 100)
let array = []
for (let i = 0; i < item_list.length; i ++) {
  let response = java.ajax('https://novel.snssdk.com/api/novel/book/directory/detail/v1/?item_ids='+item_list[i])
  let data = JSON.parse(response).data
  data.forEach((x) => {
    array.push({
      name: x.title,
      url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(x.item_id)},{"type":"pyfqc"}`,
      info: ((Number(x.volume_name) == 0?"第一卷：默认": x.volume_name)+' · '+java.timeFormat(x.first_pass_time*1000)+' · '+x.chapter_word_number+'字')
    })
  })
}
array
</js>

	}
result.description += y
}

try{ book_id=$[x].internal_book_id; }

<js>
if(baseUrl.match(/cdn\/book\/chapterList/)){
eval(String(source.bookSourceComment));
data = JSON.parse(decode(result)).result.list;
length = data.length;
chapterList = [];
for(var i = 0; i < length; i ++){
	name = "🏮〖"+data[i].name+"〗🏮";
	chapterList.push({
			text: name,
			href: null,
			volume: true
	})	
	data[i].list.forEach(($) => {						
		text = $.name;
		id = $.id;
		book_id = java.get('book_id');
		//book_id = baseUrl.match(/\/(\d+).html/)[1];
    href = `/cdn/book/content/${book_id}/${id}.html`;   
    chapterList.push({
			text: text,
			href: href	
	})
	})	
	}
chapterList
}
else{
	chapterList = [];
	datas = java.getElement("dd@a").toArray();
	//java.log(JSON.stringify(chapterList));
	for (var i = 0; i < datas.length; i++) {
    text = datas[i].text();
			hre = baseUrl.split(',')[0]+datas[i].attr("href");
			d=String(hre).split('\/');
list=[];
d.forEach((s, index)=>{ 
	 if (list.indexOf(s) == -1) {
 	   list.push(s);      }
		
		});
		href = list.toString().replace(/,/g,"/");
						
     chapterList.push({
		 	 text: text,
		  	 href: href	
      	})            
   };
	chapterList
	}
</js>

ruleBookInfo.intro:
<js>
source_url="https://novel-api.xiaoppkk.com/cdn/book/source/{{$.id}}.html";
result=java.ajax(source_url);
eval(String(source.bookSourceComment));
data=JSON.parse(result).result.list;

v=String(book.getVariable("custom"));
var v=v.match(/^\d+$/)?v:0;
v=parseInt(v)<data.length?v:0;

con="\n使用说明：(根据序号设置书籍变量来切换来源(默认0))\n❗当前来源：序号【"+v+"】："+data[v].name;

for(var i=0;i<data.length;i++){
   con+="\n❤序号【"+i+"】："+data[i].name;
   con+="\n书籍ID："+data[i].internal_book_id;
   con+="\n源ID："+data[i].source_id;	
		con+="\n源选择率："+data[i].show_text;
		con+="\n源地址："+data[i].chapter_list_url;
		con+="\n更新："+data[i].new_title;
			
}


 try{ book_id=data[v].internal_book_id; }
 catch(e) { book_id = java.getString('$.id');}
 
 if(v==0&&book_id==0){ 
 	book_id = java.getString('$.id');
 	tocUrl="/cdn/book/chapterList/"+java.put('book_id',book_id)+".html";
 }
else if(v!=0&&book_id==0) {
	 tUrl=data[v].chapter_list_url;
	 tocUrl=tUrl+"," + JSON.stringify({"headers":{"Referer": tUrl}});
	}
else if(book_id!=0){ 
		tocUrl="/cdn/book/chapterList/"+java.put('book_id',book_id)+".html";
	}

java.put('tocUrl',tocUrl); 
intro = " "+java.getString('$.description')+con;
</js>

	name = "🏮〖"+data[i].name+"〗🏮";
	chapterList.push({

			href: null,
			volume: true
	})

    chapterList.push({
			text: text,
			href: href	
	})
	})	
	}
chapterList

list=[];

		});

		  	 href: href	
      	})            
   };
	chapterList

var key = java.get('key');
var page = java.get('page');
var cookieHost = java.getCookie("https://masiro.me");

var headers = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/138.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/138.0.0.0",
    "Referer": "https://masiro.me/admin/novels",
    "Connection": "keep-alive",
    "Cookie": cookieHost || "",
    "X-XSRF-TOKEN": getCookieValue(cookieHost, "XSRF-TOKEN")
};
java.put('searchHeaders', headers);

var url = "https://masiro.me/admin/loadMoreNovels?page=" + page + 
		"&keyword=" + encodeURIComponent(key) +
		"&_t=" + Date.now();

var response = java.get(url, headers);
var responseData = JSON.parse(response.body());

if (responseData.code !== 1) {
    java.error("请求失败: " + responseData.msg);
}

var resultList = [];
responseData.novels.forEach(function(novel) {
    var tags = [];
    novel.tags.forEach(function(tag) {
        tags.push(tag.name);
    });

    var translators = [];
    novel.translators.forEach(function(translator) {
        translators.push(translator.name);
    });

    var coverUrl = "https://masiro.me" + novel.cover_img;

    var novelItem = {
        id: novel.id,
        title: novel.title,
        brief: novel.brief,
        author: novel.author,
        cover: coverUrl,
        status: novel.status, // 0=连载中, 1=已完结
        wordCount: novel.words,
        updateTime: novel.updated_at,
        latestChapter: novel.new_up_content,
        tags: tags.join(", "),
        translators: translators.join(", "),
        readCount: novel.read_num,
        collectCount: novel.collect_nums,
        likeCount: novel.thumb_up,
        sourceUrl: novel.original
    };
    
    resultList.push(novelItem);
});

java.log(JSON.stringify(resultList));
result = resultList;
</js>
